premise: Rising from the chess clubs of southern India to become the undisputed World Chess Champion.
hook: He learned the rules of chess from his mother at age six in a house without a computer or grandmaster coach.
key_facts: Became India's first international chess grandmaster in 1988 at the age of 18
Won the FIDE World Chess Championship in 2000, becoming the first Indian to hold the title
Defended and retained the world championship title in 2007, 2008, 2010, and 2012
Awarded India's highest civilian sporting honor, the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna, in 1991

premise: Journeying from a small town in Haryana to becoming the first Indian-born woman in space.
hook: Growing up in a conservative Indian town where engineering was rarely pursued by women, she dreamed only of the stars.
key_facts: Graduated with an aeronautical engineering degree from Punjab Engineering College.
Moved to the United States in 1982 to earn her master's and doctorate in aerospace engineering.
Selected by NASA in 1994 and flew on Space Shuttle Columbia in 1997.

premise: Working as a carpenter on a film set when a chance reading for an audition changed his life.
hook: He was literally building cabinets for Francis Ford Coppola when he was asked to read lines for an upcoming space movie.
key_facts: Worked as a professional carpenter in Hollywood to support his family after struggling to land acting roles.
Built a doorway for George Lucas, which led to being hired to read lines for actors auditioning for Star Wars.
Cast as Han Solo after George Lucas realized he was the right fit for the role.
Became one of the most successful leading men in cinema history.

premise: Risking financial ruin to launch a pioneering IT company with a minimal loan from his wife.
hook: He started a global tech giant with just 10,000 rupees borrowed from his wife and a vision for software outsourcing.
key_facts: Co-founded Infosys in Pune, India, in 1981 with six other software engineers.
Faced extreme bureaucratic hurdles and a lack of venture capital infrastructure in early 1980s India.
Helped pioneer the global software services industry model from Bangalore.
Grew the company into one of India's largest multinational IT corporations.

premise: Pawned his wife's jewelry and used personal savings to finish his debut film 'Pather Panchali' after running out of funds.
hook: India's greatest cinematic masterpiece almost wasn't made because the production ran completely out of money halfway through.
key_facts: Worked as a commercial artist while struggling to finance his first film.
Shot 'Pather Panchali' intermittently over nearly three years using amateur actors.
The film premiered at the 1956 Cannes Film Festival and won Best Human Document.
Received an Academy Honorary Award in 1992.

premise: Refusing to accept segregated computing limitations and demanding to attend high-level mission planning briefings.
hook: She was the human computer whose calculations NASA trusted above electronic mainframes for John Glenn's orbit.
key_facts: Graduated from college at age 18 with highest honors in mathematics.
Joined the guidance and navigation department at NASA's Langley research center in 1953.
Calculated the trajectory for the 1961 Mercury flight of Alan Shepard.
Awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2015.
